Arnold-N42SH.br_basis: Published minimum at20C; nominal and maximum retained separately
Arnold-N42SH.coefficient_basis: Published reversible coefficients over20C to grade temperature limit; linear interpolation is a study approximation
Arnold-N42SH.curve_basis: Manufacturer plotted curves use nominal Br/minimum Hci and depend on size/shape; not digitised or represented as measured coupon data
Arnold-N42SH.demag_basis: Unchanged conservative80% Hcj screening factor; not a measured knee or irreversible-demagnetisation model
Arnold-N42SH.density_basis: Manufacturer typical 7.6 g/cm3; not a guaranteed batch value
Arnold-N42SH.recoil_basis: Declared linear-recoil study assumption1.05, not measured Arnold batch permeability

aluminium.source: Nominal geometry mass assumption, alloy/certificate unconfirmed

copper.basis: Declared nominal annealed copper study constants; actual winding conductor certification required.

steel.curve_basis: Hand digitized typical 50Hz polarization graph, with exact 2500/5000/10000 A/m table anchors. B=J+mu0H; +/-0.03T and +/-10%H reading uncertainty, not a measured DC/reversible law. High-field extrapolation uses vacuum slope.
steel.facing_grade_hold: Solid facing grade, B-H curve, joints, corrosion and eddy losses unqualified
steel.origin_basis: SIJ Acroni Slovenian electrical steel; UK cut/stack manufacture possible, British raw steel origin not established.
